description: A plate appearance interrupted by a mid-AB baserunning event. In ACTUAL Chadwick cwevent OUTPUT the completed PA surfaces as ONE BAT_EVENT_FL=T row whose PITCH_SEQ_TX carries the FULL CUMULATIVE pitch sequence with the Retrosheet '.' interruption marker preserved verbatim; the interrupting event is a separate BAT_EVENT_FL=F row and is NEVER a second PA. Normalization strips the '.' marker in a single pass (it never concatenates fragments from separate records). Real example: batter forsl001 vs pitcher bardl001, ANA201904040, top of the 5th, PITCH_SEQ_TX '.BBCX' -> single (a runner had reached on the prior walk; the baserunning play created the record boundary the leading '.' marks).

raw.note: Fields are the exact cwevent output columns emitted under the frozen argument set (docs/plate/pr7a0-proof/PARSER_IDENTITY.txt). cwevent passes PITCH_SEQ_TX verbatim and does NOT strip the '.'. The interrupting baserunning event is emitted separately as a BAT_EVENT_FL=F row (it carries no pitches for this PA and creates no second plate appearance); there is nothing to concatenate.

reassembly.note: The single BAT_EVENT_FL=T row already carries the full cumulative sequence '.BBCX'. Normalization removes the '.' interruption marker (a non-pitch marker) in one pass -> [B,B,C,X]. There is NO second record to concatenate; the interrupting baserunning event is a distinct BAT_EVENT_FL=F row that adds no pitches and no PA.
